mostWorthwhile.text: Reviewing Moth's proposed rounds with the neighbors was most worthwhile: a distance-based ordering became a human decision about priority and staffing.

leastWorthwhile.text: Lodging the appeal felt comparatively procedural, though the delayed response clearly established its limits.

surprise.text: Moth's distance grouping put the upstairs water request last, revealing that an apparently neutral route choice also set priorities.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; the offered combinations made their immediate purposes reasonably clear.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see whether the appeal changes anything and how the neighborhood handles work that remains unfinished, although the menu-driven combinations leave little compatibility discovery.
